origin_instruction: Stand outside the lift. Point the camera at the large floor number 3 beside the lift doorway.
origin_retry: I only know the saved route from the lift lobby to the toilet. Please check the lift lobby again.

origin.description: Large number 3 on a white wall just outside a stainless-steel lift doorway
required_features: Large floor numeral on the white lobby wall beside the stainless-steel lift doorway
origin.question: The floor number 3 and lift doorway appear to match. Are you standing outside this lift in the lobby?

checkpoints.description: Office for Research & Innovation sign on the glass frontage beside the corridor
required_features: The sign is on a glass office frontage beside the corridor
checkpoints.question: Are you beside the glass frontage marked Office for Research & Innovation?

checkpoints.description: Two wheelchair symbols on wood paneling beside the louvered toilet entrance
required_features: Two separate white signs bearing wheelchair pictograms are stacked vertically on wood paneling
A large pale louvered door is immediately beside those wheelchair signs
checkpoints.question: Are you outside the toilet entrance beside the two wheelchair signs and the louvered door?

arrival: You have reached the outside of the toilet entrance. Route finished. Camera stopped.
